title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp Charlie Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy 1982 show with standout Peggy‑O, Birdsong, Sugaree and an inspired Jerry on Estimated.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its tight playing, soaring guitar work from Jerry (especially on Estimated) and memorable renditions of Peggy‑O, Birdsong, Sugaree, Deal and Stella Blue. The Charlie Miller‑treated soundboard is generally described as crisp with excellent drum presence, though a few listeners note it sounds a bit dry compared to audience tapes. Overall the show feels rare and energetic, making this recording a favorite for many Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight strong playing and a clear soundboard; only a minority note recording dryness or slight performance lapses, yielding an overall rating just above good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix with clear drums and prominent Jerry; Charlie Miller treatment praised. Some listeners describe the SBD as a bit dry/sterile versus audience tapes, but overall it is clean and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with tight playing; second set builds energy through Peggy‑O, Birdsong and Sugaree before winding down on The Other One. Transitions are smooth and the overall pacing is lively.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for firey guitar tone (especially on Estimated) and strong vocals on T‑Jed; a few note he isn’t as “on fire” as usual but still solid.
band_member_comments.Phil: Drum sound highlighted as great; Phil’s bass is well‑balanced in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mixed remarks – some say his vocal delivery is slurred, others commend his contribution on Sugaree and overall tightness.
band_member_comments.Drums: Consistently praised for crisp, powerful presence in the mix.
